messages:
incident_bot: ALERT: elevated gateway 5xx rate detected for inference-gateway-prod. error_rate_5m=17% (normal <0.5%). source: envoy upstream clusters. auto-page: oncall-sre. correlated config change: route table update 22m ago.

emma (SRE): ack. pulling up envoy /stats and cluster health. posting any suspect traces.

theo (runtime): seeing lots of upstream 502 and 504. envoy shows many upstream_rq_5xx and upstream_cx_connect_fail spikes. Two upstream clusters for model-backend show high active_pending and open_connections.

liam (network): I didn't push infra changes. which route change was applied?

oscar (eng-runtime): i pushed a small canary earlier to shift 8% traffic to variant-b. change snippet:
```yaml
- match: /v1/predict
  weighted_clusters:
    - name: stable
      weight: 92
    - name: variant-b
      weight: 8
  retry_policy:
    num_retries: 2
    retry_on: gateway-error,5xx,connect-failure
  per_try_timeout: 3s
```

emma (SRE): interesting - per_try_timeout + retries + variant with slower cold-start could amplify load. I'm seeing cb_open and pending_request overflow on variant-b cluster. cb counters incremented right after the weight change.

oscar (eng-runtime): variant-b had a change to model init path; it can be slower under burst. didn't expect this under small percentage.

emma (SRE): immediate mitigation proposal: 1) revert route weights (put 100% back to stable) 2) set gateway envoy retry num_retries=0 (avoid proxy retries) 3) temporarily increase CB limits to avoid premature tripping while we scale 4) scale variant-b to handle warmup 5) notify support/pm. I'll start reverting weights now.

oscar (eng-runtime): rolling back weight: `kubectl apply -f route-stable.yaml`

incident_bot: deploy-bot: rollback requested by oscar at 2000123502. status: success.

emma (SRE): rollback applied. monitoring for drop in 5xx.

theo (runtime): patching gateway envoy config to remove retry_on and set num_retries: 0. pushing change to 2 regions.

liam (network): temporarily bumping envoy circuit_breaker thresholds on model-backend clusters: max_pending_requests 2048 -> 8192, max_connections -> 20000. This is temporary to let pods drain and scale.

maya (support): what is customer-visible impact? any enterprise tenants hit?

emma (SRE): rough estimate: approx 20% of requests during peak returned 5xx/timeouts. We have Sentry traces and request-ids for some enterprise calls. we'll escalate 1:1 for confirmed tenants.

claire (PM): ETA for stabilization? need a short blurb for stakeholders.

emma (SRE): error rate dropping: 5m avg now 4.5%, 1m avg 1.2%. if this trend holds we'll be in control in ~25-40m. continuing to monitor.

oscar (eng-runtime): while rollbacks help, we should also collect heap/pprof from variant-b pods; I see repeated connection resets during init. adding a canary smoke test to pipeline.

emma (SRE): scaling model-backend for short window: `kubectl scale deploy model-backend --replicas=15` to reduce queuing.

incident_bot: ONCALL HANDOFF scheduled: current oncall emma -> sre-next-oncall at 2000123600.

emma (SRE): handing off to @sre-next-oncall. mitigations applied: route rollback, disabled proxy retries, increased CB limits temporarily, scaled backends. I'll keep watching for 30m.

sre-next-oncall: acked. I'll be monitoring dashboards and traces. please drop any logs or pprofs here.

maya (support): CS notified high-touch customers with templated note. drafting follow-up update after RCA.

claire (PM): please include concrete timeline and exact mitigations in the customer follow-up. also list next-steps to prevent recurrence.

oscar (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: variant-b has slower TCP connect/initialization causing upstream to appear unhealthy; envoy proxy retries + per_try_timeout resulted in request amplification and circuit breaker trips. will add a perf gate on canaries and remove aggressive retries from gateway config.

emma (SRE): monitoring shows steady improvement. 12m stable window with 1m error rate <0.8%. marking mitigations successful but leaving thread open for postmortem link.

sre-next-oncall: confirming stable for 15m. elevating to follow-up action: postmortem, perf test for canary pipeline, tighten retry policy defaults.

maya (support): CS will send post-incident update to affected customers with timeline and steps taken.

oscar (eng-runtime): creating postmortem draft: /docs/incidents/2000123456-postmortem.md will link back here. adding perf test ticket to sprint.

emma (SRE): closure note: cause = canary weight to variant-b that had slower startup/latency; proxy retries + per_try_timeout amplified load and tripped envoy CBs causing 5xx cascade. actions taken: revert weights, disable proxy retries, temporarily expand CBs, scale backends, collect diagnostics. follow-ups: add smoke/perf checks to canary, tighten retry defaults, add alert for sudden upstream CB counter increases.

incident_bot: INCIDENT MOVED TO MONITORING. will auto-close after 24h of stable metrics.
